declarations.name: Causal.scaledFan_separates
declarations.notes: Closed statement, no hypotheses. 26 conjuncts. Restated in an audit probe (deleted) with the ladder's fully qualified node names: T2Space, SecondCountableTopology, Causal.Precausality.AbsolutelyMinimal scaledFan.toPrecausality, the same with ∀ W : Opens, AbsolutelyMinimalOn W, then CausallyArcConnected, PushUp, LocallyPushUp, IsCausal, CausallyCompact, GloballyHyperbolic, HasTimeFunction, CurvesExtend, FutureOneConnected, ∀ W FutureOneConnectedOn W, ¬ LocallyStronglyCausal, ∀ W ∋ scaledFanA, ¬ StronglyCausalOn W, and ¬ of StronglyCausal, StronglyCausalOpen, Tarentin, ChronalNeighbours, CausallyPlain, HasChronalNeighbourEverywhere, CausallyOpenFuture, CausallyOpen, LocallyCausallyOpenFuture, LocallyCausallyOpen. `example : <that> := scaledFan_separates` elaborates, so every conjunct is the `lean` name of its programme/ladder.toml [[property]] (all 21 causality-sort nodes). 10 held and 11 lacked, as claimed. The heart, GH ∧ CC ∧ ¬ LSC, holds on the ambient (T2 and second countable are conjuncts 1–2). Neither ¬ LSC form is vacuous. LocallyStronglyCausal = ∀ p, ∃ W open, p ∈ W ∧ StronglyCausalOn W (Causal/DiamondConfinement.lean:378). StronglyCausalOn W = ∀ p ∈ W, ∀ U ∈ 𝓝 p, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 p, V ⊆ U ∧ CausallyConvexIn V W (:371). Conjunct 16 covers W = ⊤, which holds a, and StronglyCausalOn is not trivially false on arc causalities (loopFan_locallyStronglyCausal). The proof's argument is sound: level k with 2·2⁻ᵏ < r lies in the sup ball, U = {Z < 2⁻ᵏ}, both feet of a loop (k, n) in V, and the top at height 2⁻ᵏ(1 + ε_n) is in diamond_W(feet) but not in U. Future one-connectedness is genuinely vacuous (≪ = False in arcCausality, so futureOneConnectedOn_of_forall_not_lt applies; kb/0297), and it is the ladder's Causal.Causality.FutureOneConnected (= FutureOneConnectedOn ⊤).

declarations.name: Causal.scaledFanSet / scaledFanγ / scaledFan (the carrier)
declarations.notes: scaledFanSet = insert (0,0,0) (⋃ i, range (scaledFanArc i)). The range is over all t ∈ ℝ, but loopArc is clamped (clampUnit). The probe proved scaledFanArc i t = scaledFanArc i (clampUnit t), so the carrier is exactly a together with the arcs over [0, 1]. The probe also proved that a lies on no arc. scaledFan = arcCausality scaledFanγ (rfl), the library's arc causality. ArcCoherent is proved (scaledFanγ_coherent). Arcs of distinct indices are disjoint: across levels by scaledFanArc_level_eq, a Lean statement; within a level by loopγ_coherent's proof that n = m. Each arc is injective on [0, 1], since levelEmbed_injective is composed with the loop fan's injective tents. The feet of every level tend to a (tendsto_scaledFanP/Q). Level k is a linear, not similar, copy (x, y) ↦ 2⁻ᵏ(x, ε_k x, y). The SCOPE discloses this, and the target allows 'an equivalent carrier the closer reports'. Since this is a layer-1 witness, only the model's own properties matter.

checks.findings_checked: (1) 'Causally open in no form'. Re-derived by hand. The top y = (0, 0, 1) of tent (1, 0) is the limit of the level-0 tops (0, 0, 1 + ε_m). On the rising leg of level 1, Y = X/2 < X, so y ∈ J⁺_W(W ∩ {Y < X}). Level 0 lies in Y = X, and by coherence a level-0 point is reached only from its own arc. So J⁺_W(V) misses the level-0 tops and is not open. The other three forms follow by causal_ladder read backwards. LscSeparations' SCOPE (:76) does argue the single loop fan causally open, and there (0, 1) is on no tent. The contrast is real. The finding is true. (2) The ladder's 'a level k with 2⁻ᵏ ∈ (ρ, r/4]' (ladder.toml:5635): for r = 0.9 and ρ = 0.2, (0.2, 0.225] holds no power of 1/2 (0.25, 0.125). True, and harmless as stated. The variant 'height in (ρ, r/2]' contains (r/4, r/2], hence a level.

findings.what: The checklist row 'the copies' arcs pairwise disjoint, accumulating at a | ✓ scaledFanγ_coherent' cites a statement weaker than the claim. ArcCoherent only says that two arcs through one point reach it at the same parameter and agree before it, which allows shared initial pieces. It does not say that arcs of distinct indices are disjoint. Disjointness is true. Across levels it is Lean (scaledFanArc_level_eq, :182). Within a level it is only inside the proof of the library's loopγ_coherent (n = m), not a stated theorem.
findings.fix: Cite scaledFanArc_level_eq for disjointness across levels, and say that within a level it is the loop fan's (loopγ_coherent's proof). Alternatively, add a one-line lemma `scaledFanArc i s = scaledFanArc j s' → s, s' ∈ Icc 0 1 → i = j`. Neither change touches any statement the ladder uses.
